# RecruitmentOS

> RecruitmentOS provides done-for-you outbound business development (BD) systems for recruitment, staffing, and executive search agencies. We engineer and operate dedicated outbound acquisition engines—sourcing live hiring signals, running waterfall enrichment, managing multi-domain infrastructure, and triaging replies so recruitment founders and consultants only handle qualified hiring-manager conversations.

## Core Offer & What We Do

RecruitmentOS replaces the manual prospecting burden for recruitment, staffing, and executive search firms with an end-to-end outbound infrastructure operated directly on client-owned assets:
- **Hiring Signal Engine:** Detects active hiring triggers across job boards, executive departures, funding announcements, and company expansions before roles go broad.
- **Waterfall Enrichment:** Validates direct contact details across 20+ verified data sources (Clay, Apollo, Hunter, Lusha, Kaspr, Sales Navigator) to maintain sub-2% bounce rates.
- **Domain-Isolated Infrastructure:** Provisions and warms dedicated secondary domains, DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and custom tracking domains to preserve primary domain reputation.
- **Human Reply Triage:** Evaluates inbound replies with a strict sub-24h SLA, filtering out-of-office notices and non-committal responses so recruiters only step in when hiring managers express verified interest.

## Guarantees & Commercial Safeguards

- **60-Day Delivery Guarantee:** 100 verified hiring-manager contacts in 60 days, or we work free until delivered.
- **7-Component Qualified Meeting Contract:** Every meeting or positive handoff must satisfy seven agreed criteria: (1) correct executive title, (2) verified hiring authority, (3) niche industry match, (4) confirmed current hiring need, (5) confirmed budget band, (6) agreed next step, and (7) confirmed calendar briefing.
- **100% Client Data & Infrastructure Ownership:** All secondary domains, DNS configurations, warmed mailboxes, sequence copy, and enriched prospect lists remain 100% owned by the client. If engagement ends, the entire system continues running independently.
- **Commercial Models:**
  - *Managed Capacity Sprint:* $1,000/mo retainer sprint (3-month sprint, 12+ verified positive replies/month guaranteed, saving 37.5% per reply).
  - *Pay per Positive Reply:* $200 per verified positive reply (<24h SLA, 5-day dispute window, $1,000 setup).
  - *Pay per Booked Meeting:* $250 per confirmed calendar briefing with a qualified hiring executive ($0 on no-shows).
